subject: National Book Awards 2026
query: when are the national book awards 2026
title: When are the National Book Awards 2026? Date, host and finalists
answer: The winners of the 77th National Book Awards will be announced on Wednesday, Nov. 18, 2026, at 8 p.m. Eastern, at a ceremony at Cipriani Wall Street in New York. Actor Kyle MacLachlan hosts, and the event is livestreamed free at nationalbook.org and on the National Book Foundation's YouTube channel.
body:
Awards are given in five categories: Fiction, Nonfiction, Poetry, Translated Literature and Young People's Literature. Each winner receives $10,000, a bronze medal and a statue, and each finalist receives $1,000 and a bronze medal. Michelle Zauner is the musical guest.

The fiction finalists are Hannah Lillith Assadi's "Paradiso 17," Edwidge Danticat's "Dèy," Julián Delgado Lopera's "Pretend You're Dead and I Carry You," Valeria Luiselli's "Beginning Middle End" and Morgan Thomas's "Mad Eden." The translated literature finalists include Karl Ove Knausgaard's "The School of Night," translated by Martin Aitken.

The Young People's Literature finalists are Elana K. Arnold's "Holloway," Tae Keller's "When Tomorrow Burns," Keala Kendall's "That Which Feeds Us: A Hawaiian Gothic," David Levithan and Gabriel Duckels's "The Fight of Our Lives: AIDS in America" and Julian Randall's "Shook." The poetry finalists include Victoria Chang's "Tree of Knowledge" and Brenda Hillman's "Still House in the Desert."
